limitations.note: The patch correctly gated the counter on an input handshake, but also removed the original `ready_b` gate on loading the first value, changing `data_out` when a group starts with downstream not ready.
The scoreboard assumed each group starts from zero regardless of `ready_b`, so it endorsed the extra behavior change instead of detecting the mismatch.
The same testbench was submitted three times because the first wrapper used a rejected cleanup command and the second invoked an unavailable `python` executable.
